goal: Complete Workshop source-to-canonical reading and the Firebase Google session handoff, with cancellation, recovery and real browser coverage; purchased-scope UI remains a separate lane.
acceptance_tests: Both banks complete vehicle selection, source-first article read, and canonical transition.
Changing articles cancels or ignores stale source/detail responses.
Document-only content is recognized as readable.
Failure/retry keeps available source content visible with honest status.
Hostile source/CSS/media fixtures cannot trigger active execution or external browser requests.
Real browser acceptance covers keyboard navigation, cold/warm reads and reload.

Expired local media URLs trigger at most one automatic detail renewal per selected view, reconcile by stable asset identity without replacing unchanged content, and stop on cancellation, denial or repeated failure.

Bootstrap public GET /auth/config then GET /auth/session using same-origin credentials; only complete Firebase configuration with explicit login_available:true offers Google popup sign-in through the pinned Firebase web SDK.

After popup sign-in exchange a fresh Firebase ID token using POST /auth/firebase/session JSON, exact Origin and X-Autodata-Session-Exchange:1; then read the opaque-cookie /auth/session contract. Never use /auth/login or /auth/callback, a demo session, localStorage token or Authorization bearer fallback.

Handle popup blocked/cancelled, stale-auth reauthentication, unavailable/malformed config, expired session401, blocked403 and dependency503 distinctly. Local login_available:false or missing/invalid availability clears protected content and offers no demo login or retry/redirect loop.

Use session CSRF and same-origin Origin for logout and cookie mutations; cancel polling/renewal and clear protected content on logout/denial, and sign out the Firebase browser instance on application logout.

Deterministic browser fixtures intercept auth config/exchange/session/logout and Firebase popup boundaries without live identity calls; cover valid session, fresh exchange, expired session, local unavailable, popup cancel/block,403 and503 separately. Fixtures do not certify real Firebase registration.
Keep payment, purchased configuration+region selection/checkout/library UI and paid access claims outside this R4 session/content lane; those require a separately synchronized commerce plan.
forbidden_scope: Changing the autonomy policy or weakening required checks
Publishing secrets or private source payloads
Editing paths outside the assigned scope
Changing the requested gpt-6.1-sol / medium / Fast execution profile or silently falling back to another model or tier

compatibility.api: Preserve existing consumers with additive versioned fields; run compatibility checks.
compatibility.events: Preserve event identity and make duplicate delivery idempotent.
compatibility.schema: Forward-only additive migrations with clean and upgrade verification; no destructive edits to historical migrations.
